environment.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with custom semantic CSS custom properties

baselineDesignSystem.name: Stryde Operational Baseline
baselineDesignSystem.note: Represents the existing implementation baseline, not the desired final redesign.

contextFiles.description: Concise product identity, unified pursuit loop, and target user profiles
Exhaustive inventory of routes, header shells, cards, and disclosures
Immutable state invariants, runner honesty, epistemic hierarchy, and manual fallbacks
Stryde quality gate rules against generic AI styling and the 3 diagnostic design tests
Catalog of grounded UX failure modes and friction points to address in visual design
External reference synthesis (SmoothUI, Canvas, Linear, Grok) with transfer boundaries

screens.title: Home / Pursuit Index & Active Continuation
screens.description: Signed-in intake surface showing 'What needs to move?' box, live pursuit search, status filters (All/Active/Done), and active pursuit list with continue indicator.

screens.title: Pursuit Workspace / Operational Brief & Record
screens.description: Desktop workspace anchor featuring the Top Operational Brief (state badge, situation summary, current bottleneck, knowns/unknowns), chronological Pursuit Record ledger, and sticky universal composer.

screens.title: Active Move / Human Action & Inline Reporting Dock
screens.description: Active move card assigned to the user ('Your Next Step') with instructions and inline outcome reporting controls ('Report done' / 'Report blocker') eliminating split-attention distance.

screens.title: Queued Background Runner & Degraded Recovery State
screens.description: Truthful representation of queued worker execution ('Queued for background runner (not running yet)') or stalled reassessment alert with direct 'Reassess' recovery trigger and manual completion override.

screens.title: Working Artifacts / Version Lineage & Reader View
screens.description: Deliverables inspector showing version history tags (Latest, v1..vN) reconstructed from superseded_by lineage, formatted/raw preview reader, and revision draft controls.

screens.title: Evidence Ledger / Source Provenance & Bounded Research
screens.description: Disclosed evidence ledger separating verified, reported, and evidence-linked claims, with cited source snippets, SHA-256 provenance stamps, and bounded research intake.

screens.title: Mobile Pursuit Workspace (390x844)
screens.description: Single-column mobile view with compact header pursuit switcher ('▾'), single-column Operational Brief, readable Pursuit Record entries, zero horizontal overflow, and touch-friendly bottom composer.

screens.title: Operational Landing / Initial Unauthenticated State
screens.description: Unauthenticated operational split presenting the four-step operating thesis ('Intention → Bottleneck → Next Move → Verified Outcome') alongside focused sign-in and account creation forms.
